continuous-tests.shell: while true; do sleep 1; done # needs work, we don't have unit test yet cd holi-frontends; jest -w

oathkeeper.shell: cd holi-unified-api/oathkeeper; docker run --rm --name ory-oathkeeper-unified-api -p 4455:4455 -p 4456:4456 --env-file=.env.local --mount type=bind,source=$PWD,target=/opt/oathkeeper/ oryd/oathkeeper --config /opt/oathkeeper/config.yaml serve

okuna-services.shell: cd holi-okuna; pip3 install -r requirements-cli-only.txt; python3 okuna-cli.py up-services-only

okuna-server.comment: Before starting the server process, the services need to be up. Therefore, we wait until the services are up via a small until loop.
okuna-server.shell: cd holi-okuna; until docker ps|grep okuna-worker; do sleep 1; done; source .venv/bin/activate; pip3 install -r requirements.txt; python3 manage.py runserver localhost:8000 || echo 'maybe you need to execute "python manage.py migrate" again?'
